missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Завод' is a masculine noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Старый' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'этот' points to a specific factory.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'На заводе' uses the prepositional form 'заводе' after 'на', the standard way to say where someone works. The masculine ending is '-е'.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Завод' is accusative after 'на', marking motion to the factory. The inanimate masculine keeps the nominative form.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Завода' is the genitive singular required by 'около'. The masculine ending '-а' marks the location near the factory.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Завода' is the genitive singular after 'из', marking motion out of the factory. The masculine ending is '-а'.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Заводу' is the dative singular after 'к', marking direction toward the factory. 'Старому' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of location. 'Заводом' is the instrumental singular after 'за', marking position behind the factory. The masculine ending is '-ом'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Завод' is the accusative direct object of 'построил'. As an inanimate masculine noun it keeps the nominative form. 'Большой' agrees.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Заводов' is the genitive plural required after 'много'. The masculine ending '-ов' is standard for counting factories.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Заводы' is the nominative plural subject of 'выпускают'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, pointing to specific factories.
